notes.title: Patch V. 1.03
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed descriptions of certain achievements to more correct ones
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when you hit a ball in slo-mo with Ball Fracture perk purchased
[*] Fixed a bug that caused fractured balls to sometimes respawn in the middle and go through walls
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused ball launcher shoot a small size ball when player has a Ball Fracture perk
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to not lose progress on death after certain manipulations on True mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V. 1.02
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Made the main ball a bit brighter for better visibility
[*]Swapped the challenges of level set 7 and level 27 because the latter one was too hard to complete
[/list]
[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new ball skin that has better visibility and is unlocked from the start
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Holoballs to break when you have a Fractured Balls perk
[*]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused perks duplicate in the shop
[*]Fixed a bug that caused HP bar not show at the start of a level when you have an Automatic Repair perk
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V 1.01 changelog
notes.content:
[list]
[*]fixed leaderboards not showing up until you beat all levels in a set.

notes.title: Destructure: Among Debris is available now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Destructors!

We are extremely happy to announce that [b]Destructure: Among Debris[/b] has finally emerged on the surface of existence from the depth of our underground lair where it was brewing to become the most destructive experience possible.

[previewyoutube=1VkPkBQulOI;full][/previewyoutube]



In case you forgot what [b]Destructure[/b] is, we want you to remind you that it is a blend of break breaker, air hockey and shoot'em up. If you ever played air hockey and thought to yourself "man, I wish I could shoot and also wreck the whole table" (probably never, but...) then this is the experience crafted right for you.

Here's what you will experience in the game:
[list]
[*]Over 150 levels across 5 unique areas, filled with tons of structures, hazards, turrets, and obstacles for you to destroy.
[*]9 power-ups: 5 various bad-ass weapons, 3 ball modifiers, a shield and repair (which is sort of lame but extremely useful).
[*]Unique challenges that change the way levels are played and offer some powerful and desirable rewards.
[*]Dozens of perks that not only make you stronger but can change the way the game is played in significant ways.
[*]A wide selection of skins to make your tools of destruction more fashionable and quirky.
[*]Awesome visuals and sounds to make your destructive experience more immersive.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/5dbee95faa57ff0d9bc1d3aef5c44da17fb7c16d.gif[/img]

We will be happy to hear your feedback to make our game even better!

Our game is also featured in these bundles:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30707/Scrapnaut_Among_Debris
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30706/Destructure_Hazard
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30737/Destructure_First_Hazard

notes.title: Destructure release date reveal!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/e44ecd2ba5f90465856b1736e5f50384663c0cc2.png[/img]

[*]9 power-ups: 5 various bad-ass weapons, 3 ball modifiers, a shield and repair (which is sort of lame but extremely useful).
[*]Unique challenges that change the way levels are played and offer some powerful and desirable rewards.
[*]Dozens of perks that not only make you stronger but can change the way the game is played in significant ways.
[*]A wide selection of skins to make your tools of destruction more fashionable and quirky.

Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist so you'll be notified as soon as [b]Destructure: Among Debris[/b] is released.

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Skins
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Destructors! [/b]

Here’s some [b]BREAKING NEWS[/b]: We are adding skins to Destructure! 

In the dusty, desolate world of the apocalypse there are few ways left to truly stand out amongst 
the endless piles of trash and rubble. But even in the bleakest of times it doesn’t hurt to look 
really, really cool. Current players of Destructure might already have thought, in a moment of 
slight narcissistic reflection: “Do I look cool enough, destroying this random metal garbage 
pile?” 

Well here’s the good news. We are implementing some fancy skins for you to unlock through 
your trials on the battlefield. Here’s what you can expect: 
- You’ll be able to unlock 9 unique skins for your Round Thingy of Destruction by playing the 
game well and completing additional challenges scattered throughout the campaign. 
But it doesn’t stop there! Because now you will also be able to [b]CUSTOMIZE YOUR BALLS[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/42c80e55a1007293966b6e9bd4c1e93657cb005b.jpg[/img]

- Unlock 12 unique ball-skins. Similar to Round Thingy of 
Destruction unlocks, you unlock these by simply playing the game and doing challenges 
when applicaple. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/da1c0874b8f39254e85384ceb7a5a37f00b74faf.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now. 

As always - Don’t forget to wishlist and check in for more updates on Destrucutre: Among 
Debris!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/d04a289003e64076823669c35f1c3726bce3e4c1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Playtest starts NOW!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, Destructors![/b][/h3]

We are happy to announce that we are launching a playtest of our game [b]Destructures: Among Debris[/b]. Now you have a chance to endure half an hour of carnage and leave your feedback on how destructive the experience was!

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825210/DESTRUCTURE_Among_Debris/ ]Visit our game page and join the Playtest from there![/url][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/62999ff9ee3b86f9cc14ef2f8d4bc966cdf8318d.jpg[/img]

Our goal is to improve and polish our game to be able to deliver best experience possible in the final version. For us it is very important that the game is as fun as possible and runs smoothly so nothing would distract players from the destruction.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825210/DESTRUCTURE_Among_Debris/ 
Don't forget to add the full game to your wishlists so you would be reminded when it is finally out.

notes.title: Sign up for the Playtest!
notes.content:
We are excited to inform you that we are launching a [b]public playtest[/b] of our game soon! 
Our team decided to move the development of [b]Destructure: Among Debris[/b] from our hidden underground lair to public to get your feedback on how we can improve the game further. 
And you can [b]sign up[/b] right now! Just go to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1825210/DESTRUCTURE_Among_Debris/]steam page[/url] and click here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/a2ad65ce2d52f7db3538a2e87b1e2f1a5ace96d7.png[/img]

Friendly reminder of what awaits you in [b]Destructure: Among Debris[/b]:
[list]
[*] lots and lots of carnage
[*] a selection of dangerous weapons and powerups
[*] progression system that opens different ways to customize your destructive potential
[*] more than 150 levels spread across 5 unique areas
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/b56d8a235cdfb3b5040738a04a20af3551efd12e.gif[/img]

Don't forget that we also will be participating and Steam Next Fest in June! That's another way to try out our game and leave feedback.

And add our game to your wishlist of course!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41549100/d04a289003e64076823669c35f1c3726bce3e4c1.gif[/img]
